welcome:
🎬 Welcome to Series Search TV!

✨ Find the next episodes of your favorite AI series!

🔎 Tap “Search” and enter the series title in the search field.

🍿 Enjoy watching!
captcha_prompt: 🔐 Enter the five digits shown in the image.
captcha_locked: ⏳ Verification is temporarily locked for 60 seconds. Please try again later.
captcha_unavailable: ⚠️ Verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
captcha_stale: ⌛ This verification expired. Tap the button to start again.
captcha_too_many: ⛔ Too many errors. Verification is locked for 60 seconds.
inline_empty: 🎬 Enter a series title to search.
inline_no_results: 🙈 No results found. Try another title.
inline_tiktok: Open the first episode on TikTok
inline_captcha_required: Open the bot and complete verification first.
subscription_required: 📣 Subscription to the channel is required to access the catalog and search. Subscribe and tap “Check subscription”.
admin_select_language_welcome: Choose the language of the welcome text to edit:
admin_empty_welcome: ⚠️ Welcome text cannot be empty. Please try again.
admin_long_welcome: ⚠️ Text is too long. Maximum length is 3500 characters.
admin_welcome_error: ⚠️ Could not read or save the welcome text.
admin_welcome_stale: ⌛ This preview expired. Start editing again.
admin_access_denied: ⛔ You do not have access to the administrator panel.
admin_activation_unavailable: Administrator activation is unavailable for this account.
admin_retry_after: Too many attempts. Try again in 60 seconds.
admin_private_only: The administrator panel is available only in a private chat.
catalog_stats_unavailable: ⚠️ The catalog is unavailable, so series statistics are not shown.
admin_statistics: 📊 Statistics 👥 Total users: {total} ✅ CAPTCHA passed: {captcha} 🛡 Administrators: {admins} 🎬 Series: {series} 🆕 New today (UTC): {today} 📅 New in 7 days: {week} 🚫 Blocked the bot: {blocked} 📢 Completed broadcasts: {broadcasts}
search_unavailable: ⚠️ The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
welcome_unavailable: ⚠️ The welcome message is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
technical_error: ⚠️ A technical error occurred. Please try again later.
series_imgbb_photo: The photo will be published on ImgBB.
series_add_preview: 👀 Preview 🎬 Title: {title} 🔗 Link: {url} {photo_status} Save this series?
series_catalog_error: ⚠️ The catalog is damaged or unavailable. Check the file and its backup.
series_enter_title: Enter the series title. Use /cancel to cancel.
series_empty_title: The series title cannot be empty. Please try again.
series_enter_tiktok: Enter the TikTok link to the first episode:
series_invalid_tiktok: The link is invalid. Send a valid TikTok URL.
series_add_stale: This add step has expired. Open the panel and start again.
series_add_photo_prompt:
Send a series photo. When saved, it will be uploaded to ImgBB and made public.
If you do not need an image, tap “No photo”.
series_photo_too_large: The photo is too large. Send an image up to 10 MB or choose “No photo”.
series_photo_expected: Send the image as a photo or choose “No photo”.
series_add_data_missing: Series data was not found. Start adding the series again.
series_preview_stale: This preview has expired. Start the operation again.
series_upload_poster_error: Could not upload the poster. Check the ImgBB connection and try again.
series_save_error: Could not save the series. Check the submitted data and catalog.
series_edit_question: What would you like to edit for “{title}”?
series_edit_photo_prompt:
Send a new photo for “{title}”.
The new image will replace the current one and be published on ImgBB.
series_photo_too_large_edit: The photo is too large. Send an image up to 10 MB.
series_edit_stale: This edit session expired. Start again.
series_edit_restart: Could not open the series. Start editing again.
series_photo_new_preview: 👀 New photo preview 🎬 Series: {title} Replace the current photo?
series_send_photo: Send the new image as a photo.
series_upload_photo_error: Could not upload the new photo. Check ImgBB and try again.
series_photo_save_error: Could not change the photo. Check the catalog and try again.
series_remove_photo_error: Could not remove the photo. Check the catalog and try again.
series_empty_value: This value cannot be empty. Please try again.
series_edit_missing: This series no longer exists. The operation was cancelled.
series_edit_preview: 👀 Edit preview 🎬 Title: {title} 🔗 Link: {url} Save these changes?
series_edit_save_error: Could not save the changes. Check the data and catalog.
series_delete_error: The series was not deleted: the record is missing or the catalog is unavailable.
broadcast_prompt: 📢 Enter the broadcast text. Use /cancel to cancel.
broadcast_empty: Broadcast text cannot be empty. Please try again.
broadcast_too_long: Text is too long. Maximum length is 4000 characters.
broadcast_history_error: The broadcast finished, but its statistics could not be saved.
broadcast_recovery_needed: An unfinished broadcast exists in the database. Check its status before starting another.
broadcast_wait_recovery: The broadcast is still running. Cancel it and wait for it to finish.
broadcast_recovered: The unfinished broadcast was marked as interrupted. Recipients may have received only part of it; it was not sent again.
access_blocked: Access has been blocked by an administrator.
cat_empty: No series in this section yet.
cat_unavailable: This series or section is unavailable. Open the catalog again.
cat_view_notice: You are confirming that you watched this series. The bot cannot verify TikTok viewing. Repeated confirmations do not increase the count.
cat_delete_category_confirm: Delete this category? Its series will be preserved.
cat_prompt_trend: Enter the trending period in days: 1–365. Current value:
cat_prompt_category: Enter name and order separated by |. Example: Comedy | 10
cat_invalid: Invalid data or expired button. Check the format and try again.
cat_prompt_alternative_titles: Enter up to 20 titles separated by commas, 256 characters each. To clear: -
cat_prompt_description: Enter a description, up to 500 characters. To clear: -
cat_prompt_episode_count: Enter episode count from 0 to 100000. 0 means unknown.
cat_prompt_category_ids: Enter category IDs separated by commas, or - to clear. Available categories:
cat_prompt_episodes: One episode per line: title | HTTPS URL. Up to 100 episodes. To clear: -
cat_prompt_publication_status: Enter published to publish, or hidden to hide the series.
cat_prompt_recommended: Enter 1 to recommend, or 0 to remove from recommendations.
